author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
What can AI ACTUALLY do? Here is what I've built with it in the past month.

I built a searchable gaming guide, automated Fedora package repository, website moderation dashboard, custom Linux desktop, cross-platform fitness tracker, and a self-hosted open-source alternative to QuickBooks.

These aren’t disposable demos or AI slop. They are real projects designed to solve problems in my work and personal life.

In this video, I show what AI development looks like when you combine capable models with Git, testing, code review, documentation, guardrails, and a solid technical foundation.

AI won’t replace understanding how software works—but it can give an experienced developer the output of an entire team.
